# Project 03 — Multi-Document RAG from Scratch

## Goal

Learn how Retrieval-Augmented Generation works from first principles before
using high-level RAG frameworks.

## Target Architecture

Multiple PDFs
→ Text Extraction
→ Chunking
→ Embeddings
→ Vector Database
→ Semantic Retrieval
→ Relevant Context
→ LLM
→ Grounded Answer + Sources
